<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import pandas as pd

# Read original matrix
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path, dtype=str)  # read all as str to preserve any content

# Determine indicator columns (all after the first three columns)
indicator_cols = df.columns[3:]

# Compute missingness per indicator
report_rows = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_cnt = df[col].isna().sum()
    total = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_cnt / total
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    report_rows.append({
        "indicator": col,
        "missing_count": missing_cnt,
        "missing_rate": missing_rate,
        "kept": "true" if kept else "false"
    })

report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_rows, columns=["indicator","missing_count","missing_rate","kept"])
report_output = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
report_df.to_csv(report_output, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

# Build selected matrix with only indicators that are kept
kept_indicators = [r["indicator"] for r in report_rows if r["kept"] == "true"]
selected_cols = ["city_id","city_name","year"] + kept_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_cols]
selected_output = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
selected_df.to_csv(selected_output, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
</solution_file>
